title: 第2章 回忆
slug: 极寒末世我有空间囤货躺平
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

2030年5月28号，林殊记得很清楚，这天是她的生日。

当天，她在房间里看书时，偶然找到了丢失很久的金色书签。

这书签是她爸爸送给她的十岁生日礼物。

本来，林殊爸爸每年都会给林殊送生日礼物，但14岁那年，父母不知为何双双自杀。

林殊一边回忆着与父母的温情往事，一边用手把玩着金色书签。

可稍有不慎，这书签竟然锋利地划破了她的手指。

顿时，金色的书签发出耀眼的光芒，书签渐渐融化，流入指尖，最后在指尖上形成一颗红痣。

林殊被这奇幻的一幕惊呆了。

研究一会儿发现，闭眼按着这颗红痣，感应它的存在，就能进入到另一个空间。

空间很大，但她肉体是进不去的，只有意识能进去。

这空间是一间巨大的仓库模样，大概有四五百平方米的样子。

里面光线很亮，仓库再远处就是白雾。

到白雾附近，林殊看不清外面的样子，用手触摸，能被看不见的空气墙阻隔。

后来多次试探空间的功能，发现它可以随时存物取物。

只是活物放不进去，放进去的东西都会随着时间静止。

热气腾腾放进去的馒头，隔天拿出来还是热气腾腾。

林殊得了空间后，虽然觉得奇幻，但好像对生活没什么影响，就没有对外人讲，只是遇到好吃的，会随手塞进空间里。

末世开始在2030年7月10日。

6月末，先是连续下了几天的暴雨。

林殊怕雨一时半会儿停不了，影响出行买菜，便在空间里囤了不少的货。

谁知这暴雨下着下着，气温越来越低，最后变成下雪。

短短一日的时间，地面积了厚厚的积雪。

学校停课，公司放假，交通瘫痪。

气温越来越低，逐渐演变成极寒天气。

林殊父母去世后，她就一直与叔叔婶婶一家住在一起。

叔叔婶婶对她关照有加，林殊便把他们当成亲生父母一样相处。

极寒末日来临，林殊空间里还有不少食物。

她毫不犹豫，便将自己有空间的事情告诉了他们。

空间里囤的食物都是全家人一起吃。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Lin Shu remembered May 28, 2030 clearly, it was her birthday.

That day, while reading in her room, she accidentally found the long-lost golden bookmark.

This bookmark was a tenth birthday gift from her father.

Originally, Lin Shu's father would give Lin Shu a birthday gift every year, but when he was 14 years old, his parents both committed suicide for unknown reasons.

Lin Shu played with the golden bookmark with his hand while recalling the tender past with his parents.

But if she wasn't careful, the bookmark cut her finger sharply.

Suddenly, the golden bookmark gave off a dazzling light. The bookmark gradually melted and flowed into the fingertip, and finally formed a red mole on the fingertip.

Lin Shu was stunned by this fantastic scene.

After a while of research, I found that if I press this red mole with my eyes closed and sense its existence, I can enter another space.

The space is huge, but her body cannot enter, only her consciousness can enter.

This space looks like a huge warehouse, about four to five hundred square meters.

The light inside is very bright, and there is white mist beyond the warehouse.

When he was near the white mist, Lin Shu couldn't see clearly what was outside. He could touch it with his hands and be blocked by an invisible wall of air.

Later, I tested the function of the space many times and found that it can store and retrieve things at any time.

It's just that living things cannot be put in, and anything put in will become stationary over time.

The steamed buns that were put in steaming hot were still steaming hot when taken out the next day.

After Lin Shu obtained the space, although he felt it was magical, it didn't seem to have any impact on his life, so he didn't tell anyone about it. He would just stuff it into the space when he encountered delicious food.

The end of the world begins on July 10, 2030.

At the end of June, it rained heavily for several days.

Lin Shu was afraid that the rain would not stop for a while and would affect his trip to buy groceries, so he stocked up a lot of goods in the space.

Unexpectedly, the heavy rain continued, the temperature became lower and lower, and finally it turned into snow.

In just one day, the ground was covered with thick snow.

Schools are closed, companies are on holiday, and traffic is paralyzed.

The temperature is getting lower and lower, gradually turning into extremely cold weather.

After Lin Shu's parents passed away, she had been living with her uncle and aunt's family.

Her uncle and aunt took good care of her, and Lin Shu treated them as her biological parents.

The end of the extreme cold is coming, and there is still a lot of food in Lin Shu's space.

Without hesitation, she told them that she had space.

The food stored in the space is eaten by the whole family.
